description: Extracts and analyzes TikTok comments from any video or creator using apidojo's TikTok Comments scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: scrape TikTok comments from a video, analyze what viewers say about a TikTok post, extract comment data for sentiment analysis, find top comments on a viral TikTok video, collect TikTok user feedback from comments, build a dataset of TikTok community reactions, study audience sentiment on TikTok content, or research what a target audience cares about from TikTok comments. Returns commenter username, comment text, likes on comment, reply count, and timestamp. Ideal for market researchers, brand managers, content creators, and academic researchers.
